name: Download File
description: Download a file (for example a zip) from a URL into the playbook run's storage, in the same `files` format as SentinelOne's Get malwares from threat, so it can be given to Submit Sample.

url.description: The http:// or https:// address of the file to download, e.g. a zip file. Only public addresses are allowed.
url.title: URL

file_name.description: The name to save the file under. Empty: the name the server gives it, or the last part of the URL.
file_name.title: File name

max_size_mb.description: The largest file to accept, in megabytes. A bigger file is dropped and the action fails.
max_size_mb.title: Max size (MB)

timeout.description: The most time, in seconds, the whole download may take.
timeout.title: Timeout (s)

verify_ssl.description: Verify the TLS certificate of the server. Turn it off only for a test server with a self-signed certificate.
verify_ssl.title: Verify SSL

path.description: The file's path in the playbook run's storage.
path.title: Path

files.description: The downloaded file as `[{"path": ...}]`, the shape SentinelOne's Get malwares from threat returns: give it as is to Submit Sample's `files`.
files.title: Files

file_name.description: The name the file was saved under.
file_name.title: File Name

size.description: Size of the file in bytes.
size.title: Size

url.description: The address the file came from, after any redirects.
url.title: Url
